exposure: protrusion of the placenta into the bladder
turbulent blood flow through the lacunae on Doppler ultrasonography
cohort: 242 women with antepartum diagnosis of placenta previa
finding: Caesarean deliveries, curettages, older age at delivery, irregularly shaped placental lacunae, protrusion of the placenta into the bladder, and turbulent blood flow through the lacunae on Doppler ultrasonography were identified as risk factors for placenta accreta in women with antepartum diagnosis of placenta previa.
mod_finding: Women with a prior cesarean delivery have a higher incidence of placenta accreta among those with an antepartum diagnosis of placenta previa.
